safety_rules: **Redirect command output to log files** - long output crashes context
**Test changes with go build before committing**
**Run go build ./... to verify full build**

issues.title: Fix SA1026 json.Marshal in persist.go
issues.description: Fix staticcheck SA1026: json.Marshal on unsupported map type in persist.go:248. The Certificate type contains Header.Payload which is a map with custom key types. Options: 1) Custom MarshalJSON for Certificate, 2) Convert map to serializable format, 3) Use different serialization.

issues.title: Fix copylocks in Certificate/Header
issues.description: Fix govet copylocks warnings: NewCertificate passes Header by value but Header contains sync.RWMutex. Change NewCertificate to take *Header instead of Header. Affects: certificate.go, and many test files calling NewCertificate(*header, ...).

issues.title: Migrate exp/light logger
issues.description: Update exp/light package to use logging.FromCometBFT() wrapper instead of CometBFT logger directly. Low priority cleanup.

issues.title: Fix rangevarref lint warnings
issues.description: Fix rangevarref warnings: Taking address of range variable is unsafe. Affected files: cert_sync.go:69,179, block.go:119,131, integration_test.go:535, stress_test.go:501, bullshark.go:172, header.go:147,164,240,257. Fix by creating a local copy before taking address.

issues.title: Fix ineffassign lint warnings
issues.description: Fix ineffassign warnings: height_test.go:152 (min not used), snapshot_test.go:440 (allCerts not used). Either use the variables or use blank identifier.

issues.title: DAG-BFT 7-node integration test under load
issues.description: Run 7 accumulated nodes with DAG-BFT consensus under 1000 TPS load for 30 minutes. Success criteria: all nodes stay in sync, no crashes/OOM, backpressure rejects (not drops), 500+ TPS sustained, stable memory, BPT roots match. Depends on #3818, #3819, #3821, #3822 completing first.
